# Siemens
> Siemens is a global technology company advancing industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare through automation, software, and digital transformation.

Siemens.com brings together corporate information, industry solutions, product portfolios, software platforms, sustainability initiatives, investor resources, and newsroom content. The site spans global business areas including industrial automation, smart infrastructure, mobility, digital industries, and technology services.

## Company
- [Siemens home](https://www.siemens.com/): Global homepage for Siemens technology, business areas, stories, and corporate navigation.
- [About Siemens](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about.html): Overview of Siemens, its purpose, businesses, and strategic direction.
- [Management](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/management.html): Leadership and governance information for Siemens AG.
- [Locations](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/locations.html): Global Siemens presence, offices, and regional footprint.
- [History](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/history.html): Corporate history, milestones, and long-term technology development.
- [Compliance](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/compliance.html): Ethics, compliance, and responsible business conduct information.

## Businesses
- [Digital Industries](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/businesses/digital-industries.html): Industrial automation, software, and digitalization business overview.
- [Smart Infrastructure](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/businesses/smart-infrastructure.html): Electrification, buildings, and energy infrastructure solutions overview.
- [Mobility](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/businesses/mobility.html): Rail, transport, and mobility technologies for passengers and freight.
- [Siemens Healthineers](https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/): Medical technology and healthcare solutions from Siemens Healthineers.
- [Siemens Financial Services](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/financing.html): Financing and commercial support for technology and infrastructure projects.
- [Siemens Xcelerator](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/xcelerator.html): Open digital business platform connecting software, hardware, and services.

## Products, Services & Solutions
- [Products, services and solutions](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products.html): Entry point to Siemens portfolios across industries and infrastructure.
- [Automation technology](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/automation.html): Industrial automation systems, controllers, drives, and engineering tools.
- [Buildings](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/buildings.html): Building technologies for safety, comfort, and operational efficiency.
- [Energy](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy.html): Energy systems and technologies for grids and electrification.
- [Mobility solutions](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html): Transportation systems, rail technologies, and digital mobility offerings.
- [Services](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/services.html): Lifecycle, maintenance, consulting, and digital services across Siemens portfolios.

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries.html): Industry-specific Siemens solutions for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.
- [Automotive](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries/automotive.html): Solutions for automotive engineering, production, and digital manufacturing.
- [Food and beverage](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries/food-beverage.html): Automation and digitalization for food and beverage production.
- [Life sciences](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries/life-sciences.html): Technologies for pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing environments.
- [Water and wastewater](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries/water.html): Digital and automation solutions for water utility operations.
- [Data centers](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/industries/data-centers.html): Infrastructure technologies for resilient and efficient data centers.

## Software & Digitalization
- [Software](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/software.html): Siemens software portfolio for engineering, operations, and lifecycle management.
- [Industrial operations X](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/software/industrial-operations-x.html): Industrial software suite for operations, data, and automation integration.
- [Digital twin](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/software/digital-twin.html): Digital twin capabilities for design, simulation, and operational optimization.
- [Industrial AI](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/software/artificial-intelligence.html): AI applications for industrial productivity, quality, and decision support.
- [Industrial Edge](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/automation/industry-software/industrial-edge.html): Edge computing platform for industrial data processing and applications.
- [Insights Hub](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/software/insights-hub.html): Industrial IoT and analytics platform for asset and operations insights.

- [Resource efficiency](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/resource-efficiency.html): Circularity and resource efficiency initiatives across operations and products.
- [Equity and employability](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/equity-and-employability.html): Workforce development, inclusion, and social impact priorities.

- [Sustainability reporting](https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/reporting.html): Reports, metrics, and disclosures related to sustainability performance.
